mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in elevated earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.2 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which translates into higher consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods where HOUST > 1200.0, or the mean 60-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% combined with a stable CPIAUCSL below 2.5% per annum indicates a controlled monetary tightening cycle that supports real interest rate stability and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS > 1.0 and CPIAUCSL < 2.5 is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 104.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, which reduces input cost volatility and supports corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 104.0, or the average 5-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market momentum that supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods where PAYEMS > 146000.0, or the mean 60-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.7% signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that lowers discount rates and increases equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.7, or the average 20-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real personal consumption expenditures below 470k million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 470000.0, or the average 20-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
